title: Mixed Event — Happy New Year! Lion Dance Robot's New Year's Show! — Episode4 Idols Have To See The First Sunrise?!

meta.Event: Happy New Year! Lion Dance Robot's New Year's Show!
meta.Episode: Episode4 — Idols Have To See The First Sunrise?!
meta.Event Outline: After successfully wrapping up their ambassadorial performances, Wonderlands×Showtime is preparing to put on a New Year's show at the new and improved Wonder Stage. Unfortunately, Lion Dance Robot seems to be feeling a bit under the weather...

rows.Line: song00004_off_f
Just before sunrise
Hiking Trail

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
H-How much more until the summit...?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<You can do it, Minori!>
<Just a little bit more! I think...>
<I've climbed this mountain before. I know it's tough, but I believe in you!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You guys...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks!
I'm gonna keep trying my best!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's supposed to get pretty steep from here, so let's pause the stream for now and resume when the trail's a little flatter.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right. We wouldn't want to fall anywhere along the way.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Then, we'll see you all in a bit!
Stay tuned to see the first sunrise of the new year!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I can't wait to see the sunrise with MMJ!>
<I can't wait to see the sun that is Shizuku!>
<Wow, Haruka seems totally fine. Keep it up, girls!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks!
See you soon!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And... Pause.
Just a bit more until the summit, so let's keep at it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <How's it going, girls?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Miku!
You came to check up on us?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<We're here too♪
Oh, are you almost at the top?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yup.
We should be there pretty soon.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Then, we came at just the right time. Also, this is such a great idea for a stream.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I agree. Not many people would say, “Let's stream the first sunrise from the top of a mountain so everyone can watch!”>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We need to thank Minori for saying how she wanted to see it with Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. All I did was suggest something that I wanted to do...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<But this trail's so dark...
Are you gonna be okay?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yup!
We looked this place up before we came, and made sure to bring lights and other hiking gear.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We also picked the easiest trail since it seemed like the most beginner-friendly.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Not only that, you can actually reach the summit by car, so we can always try calling for one if something does happen.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Plus, it's supposed to be easy to film up top because there's supposed to be this nice, flat plaza!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<I see...
Oh, I hear some other people talking. You must be close to the summit now.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Yes, but don't let up now.
You need to keep pushing until you're all at the top!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, now that we all seem ready, why don't we resume our stream?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We're back, everyone!
And we've almost reached the top!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Welcome back!>
<Oh, I see some light. You must be close.>
<You can do it MMJ!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Shizuku, the frosted parts are very slippery, so take it slow and move one step at a time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay!
I'll be careful not to slip...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hey, look! I think I see the summit...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too!
Alright, just a little bit more to go...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<The sky's so pretty!>
<The sun looks like it's about to come up!>
<Nice timing!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I'm glad we got here in time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too. And getting to welcome in the new year with all of our fans fills me with so much joy.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's all wish for this year to be a great one!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm gonna ask the sun to make sure all of you guys also get to have an amazing year! Hnng...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Her “Hnng” face is so cute lol.>
<Thanks for wishing on our behalf, Minori!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, why don't we all make a wish so that tomorrow is a better day for everyone?

rows.Speaker: Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I wish MORE MORE JUMP! will become more and more famous!>
<I wish for all of you to have a really amazing year!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, let's cap things off by presenting our New Year's resolutions!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
So, mine's...
“Hah hah hah hah!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh...?
That voice... It sounded really familiar...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “Now, to make the people of this village smile!”

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Deity
rows.Line: “CHOMP!”

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Isn't that Wonderlands×Showtime from PXL?>
<What are they doing on top of a mountain?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, are they doing a show here?
That's so wonderful...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, on top of a mountain too...
I guess that's one way to kick off the new year.

rows.Speaker: Lion-Dog
rows.Line: “Alright, let's work together to make everyone here smile!”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I see. The story is about traveling across Japan to put smiles on everyone's faces with their show...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “Now, I am happy that the Lion-Dog has decided to join me, but it would be nice to have a bigger cast for our performances... And a larger audience...”

rows.Speaker: Lion-Dog
rows.Line:
“Oh, I know...!
Why don't we gather up a bunch of people and see who if any of them want to join us?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line:
“Yes, I see.
If we gather enough people, then someone will likely ask to join our little troupe.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “Someone! Anyone! Who out there can dance?! Who would like to perform alongside us?!”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, are they asking for volunteers from the audience...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, looks like it!
Oh, some people are commenting on it...!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That looks fun!>
<Cool! You can just jump right in!>
<I love these kinds of shows!>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <MMJ should volunteer!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, since we're here, why don't we give them a hand?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Lend them a hand? How?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Like this...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “Is there no one out there who can dance for us...?!”

rows.Speaker: Dancer
rows.Line: “You rang?!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line:
“Hm?!
I thought I just heard the lovely voices of some...”

rows.Speaker: Dancer
rows.Line: “W-We're dancers who live in this village!”

rows.Speaker: Dancer
rows.Line: “If it appeases you, may we join your performance?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(What? Hanasato and Shizuku?!
Wait, hang on... It's all of MORE MORE JUMP!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line:
“Splendid!
In that case, why don't we dance together?!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui, I hope you have some music ready!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Don't worry.
I've saved thousands of songs to Robo-Nene's memory to make sure we have something to play for anyone who volunteers.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, since we have MORE MORE JUMP! here with us... Let's play... This♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This song! It sounds similar to ones by that idol group with a traditional Japanese theme, Miko Miko☆Party!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Did they choose this just for us?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If that's the case, we'll need to put on the best dance performance we can!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'm nervous about improvising a dance routine, but if it means putting smiles on everyone's faces...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay, here we go!
Viewers, get ready to be blown away!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Because you're all about to witness a never-seen-before joint performance by MORE MORE JUMP! and Wonderlands×Showtime!

rows.Speaker: Mountain Climbers
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Darn, the sun's already up... Huh? I'm hearing music coming from the summit.

rows.Speaker: Mountain Climbers
rows.Line:
Hey, there're people dancing!
Is there an event or something?

rows.Speaker: Dancer
rows.Line:
“Let's clap along together, everyone!
We have to get the attention of everyone up above!”
se_event_liondance_2023_001

rows.Speaker: Dancer
rows.Line: “So, we need to have as much fun as possible to start off the new year!”

rows.Speaker: Dancer
rows.Line:
“Keep clapping, everyone!
Let's all have as much fun as we can!”

rows.Speaker: Mountain Climbers
rows.Line:
Hey, isn't that Haruka Kiritani...?
And Shizuku Hinomori?! What are they doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Mountain Climbers
rows.Line: I have no idea, but it looks like fun... Let's go jump in!

rows.Speaker: Dancer
rows.Line:
“You're all doing great!
Next, raise your arms as high as you can! This should help you get refreshed!”
se_event_liondance_2023_001

rows.Speaker: Dancer
rows.Line:
“Ready, everyone?
Here it goes!”

rows.Speaker: Mountain Climbers
rows.Line: “Yeah!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Their energy...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (We sometimes ask the audience to clap along during our shows, but they're on a completely different level...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (However, they are idols. They excel at interacting and making connections with their fans, so I suppose it's only natural for them to get the crowd so excited.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But I can't let them hog all the glory!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “Alright, we must let the New Year's deity know that we are here! Everyone, young and old!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasanosuke
rows.Line: “That, of course, includes our lovely dancers!”

rows.Speaker: Dancers
rows.Line:
“Yeah!”
“Yes!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Things are going very well.
I believe you're up soon, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right. Here I go...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, I would like to finish by wishing all of you a Happy New Year!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And please give a big thanks to our young ladies! We were able to put on a spectacular show because of you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Bye bye!
See you all again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: They left immediately after wishing everybody well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I have a feeling that they're heading off to their next stop to do another show. We can properly thank them later when we get a chance.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Still, we danced a lot...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We climbed a mountain and danced up a storm... It's been a really fun New Year's.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<WXS×MMJ was so awesome!>
<I wanna live in this village!>
<You guys were so cool!>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<MMJ was so cute as villager girls!>
<I can't believe you improvised all of that!>
<Talk about being blown away to start the new year!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like you all enjoyed the show!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thanks to Wonderlands×Showtime, our stream became something even more special.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, it did. I'd love to keep spreading hope to everyone like this moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So!
Let's keep trying more and more and more this year too!
